name: _view.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  star-field/_view.scss — the star-field view itself: :host fullscreen mount,
//  the Three.js render canvas, and the static deep-space fallback surface.
//  Imported by star-field.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

:host {
  display: block;
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100vh;
  // The host tracks the DYNAMIC viewport, not the legacy static 100vh —
  // mobile chrome (URL bar/toolbars) inflates 100vh beyond the visible
  // area, which pushes bottom-anchored sheets past the fold where their
  // scroll edge can't be reached. dvh stays inside the visible rect.
  height: 100dvh;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--bg-darkest);

  // Themed chrome palette — the canvas is deep space in both themes, but
  // the glass chrome (panel, drawer, buttons, tooltip) follows the site
  // theme: light-glass surfaces with dark ink by default, dark glass
  // under html.dark-mode. The --sf-sky-* inks never flip — they paint
  // text directly on the starfield where no glass sits behind them.
  --sf-ink: var(--text-primary);
  --sf-ink-2: var(--text-secondary);
  --sf-ink-3: var(--text-muted);
  --sf-ink-faint: var(--text-muted);
  --sf-ink-strong: var(--text-primary);
  --sf-chrome: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 96%, transparent);
  --sf-chrome-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-primary) 85%, transparent);
  --sf-line: var(--border-color);
  --sf-line-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-color) 60%, transparent);
  --sf-field: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 6%, transparent);
  --sf-field-hover: color-mix(in srgb, var(--text-primary) 12%, transparent);
  --sf-sky-ink: var(--text-muted-on-dark);
  --sf-sky-ink-2: var(--color-white-raw);
  --sf-sky-faint: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 15%, transparent);
}

// Dark theme — the dark-glass chrome the star chart originally shipped.
:host-context(.dark-mode) {
  --sf-ink: var(--text-primary);
  --sf-ink-2: var(--text-secondary);
  --sf-ink-3: var(--text-muted);
  --sf-ink-faint: var(--text-muted);
  --sf-ink-strong: var(--color-white-raw);
  --sf-chrome: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 85%, transparent);
  --sf-chrome-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-dark) 50%, transparent);
  --sf-line: var(--border-color);
  --sf-line-2: color-mix(in srgb, var(--border-color) 60%, transparent);
  --sf-field: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 6%, transparent);
  --sf-field-hover: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-white-raw) 14%, transparent);
}

// The Three.js render canvas — FULLSCREEN behind every overlay layer.
// Only the chrome (drawer, dossier, HUD, buttons) tracks the site's
// content gutter; the scene itself bleeds to the window edge like the
// other experiments.
.#{$_B_SF}-canvas {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  z-index: 0;

  // Dead GL context after a failed boot — hidden so the CSS starfield
  // shows through instead of an opaque black framebuffer.
  &.is-fallback {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
}

// Static deep-space fallback — a 2D-painted starfield canvas mounted when
// the engine can't boot (WebGL disallowed/unavailable, init failure,
// reduced-motion). `color` doubles as the star ink — the painter reads it
// via getComputedStyle so the field follows the theme tokens.
.#{$_B_SF}-fallback {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  z-index: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  display: block;
  color: var(--sf-sky-ink-2);
  background:
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 70% 45% at 30% 40%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-blue-raw) 22%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      ellipse 50% 35% at 75% 65%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-blue-raw) 16%, transparent) 0%,
      transparent 70%
    ),
    radial-gradient(
      circle at center,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-blue-raw) 24%, transparent) 0%,
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-black-raw) 92%, transparent) 62%,
      var(--bg-darkest) 100%
    );
}
